# Hierarchy Indicator (`rphicmsgb`)

> **Status:** Stub — content to be expanded.

## Overview

`rphicmsgb` is a 9-character string pattern that indicates which PSGC hierarchy levels are active or included in a query or match result. Each position corresponds to a level; the placeholder `0` is replaced by the level's letter when that level is active.

## Positions

| Position | Letter | Level |
|----------|--------|-------|
| 1 | `r` | Region |
| 2 | `p` | Province |
| 3 | `h` | Highly urbanized city |
| 4 | `i` | Independent component city |
| 5 | `c` | Component city |
| 6 | `m` | Municipality |
| 7 | `s` | Sub-municipality |
| 8 | `g` | Special geographic area / unit |
| 9 | `b` | Barangay |

## Example

`r0h000s0b` means the result spans region, highly urbanized city, sub-municipality, and barangay levels.
